findings.message: Sources: the learning-styles evidence claim - the intellectual centre of Topic 7.1 (U7-1) - has no carrying source. sources/unit-07.md:15 registers spielman2020 as supporting the learning-styles claim and its evidence caution, and coverage/unit-07.md:8-9 maps U7-1 to spielman2020/vosniadou2001, but the bound excerpt sources/texts/spielman2020.md contains no learning-styles passage (it carries sections 5.1, 8.1, 7.4, 7.5, 10.1, 6.3, 6.4 for Units 3-6), the live cited page (OpenStax Psychology 2e Section 7.4, verified 2026-09-25) discusses Spearman/Gardner/creativity and never mentions learning styles, and the vosniadou2001 booklet (33 pages, searched in full) contains no learning-styles passage either. topic-01.mdx:171-173 points learners to that unrelated section as Further Reading. The claim itself is accurate and the repository already carries the right source: sources/texts/rohrer2012.md (Rohrer & Pashler 2012, a thoughtful review of the data provides no support for style-based instruction), bound for Unit 5 U5-1 after that unit's round-1 repair, which Unit 7 (authored earlier) does not cite. Repair: cite Rohrer & Pashler (2012) inline at the matched-teaching verdict (topic-01.mdx:47-51, as Unit 5 topic-01.mdx:97-99 does), add a rohrer2012 row to sources/unit-07.md, correct the U7-1 source cells in coverage/unit-07.md, and fix the Further Reading so the Spielman citation is scoped to the abilities material it actually supports.

Assessment: the bank deviates from the approved blueprint. content-spec.md:932-934 (verified at intake, intake-2/evaluation.md:115: 5/5 for U5/U6/U7/U10/U11) requires the 10 MCQs and 10 RRQs each spread 5/5 across topics 7.1/7.2. The authored bank is MCQ 4/6 (unit-assessment.mdx:42-101: items 1-4 test 7.1 material, items 5-10 test 7.2) and RRQ 3/7 (unit-assessment.mdx:105-121: items 1-3 test 7.1, items 4-10 test 7.2). The ERQ spread (2 + 2 + 1 integrative) matches. Repair: rebalance by moving or replacing one MCQ and two RRQs with 7.1-material items, or amend the blueprint through the owner if the 2-vs-3 sub-topic asymmetry is judged to justify a different split.

Assessment construction: 9 of the 10 MCQ keys are option (b) (unit-assessment.mdx:153-162; only MCQ 6 is c). A test-wise pupil picking (b) throughout scores 9/10. The pattern is course-wide (Unit 5: 7/10 b, Unit 6: 8/10 b) but Unit 7 is the most extreme. Repair: shuffle option positions; no content change needed.

Authority framing: unit-teacher-notes.mdx:86-89 states the guide's practical component for this chapter is a group assignment (each group walks one school as a wheelchair user would), and sources/unit-07.md:23 calls it the guide-named practical work behind the teacher notes. The guide's Practical Work list (1st 2026.txt:1160-1166) is course-generic (Hands-on Computer Exercises, Individual Assignments, Group Assignments, Presentations, Internet-Research tasks) with no chapter-specific wheelchair walk. The walk is the unit's own - and good - instantiation of the generic group-assignment slot. Repair: attribute the walk to the unit, not the guide (same advisory class as Unit 5 round 1).

Governance table: the coverage reinforcement row U7-4 (coverage/unit-07.md:23) points at topic-02.mdx's Inclusive education section, whose prose (topic-02.mdx:83-111) does not revisit gifted-learner material; the gifted branch appears in the fig-U7-3 concept map, whose carrier sits in the classroom-situation section (topic-02.mdx:36), and in the unit summary. Repair: point the row at the figure carrier or the summary.
